title: Common raw DXF section writer copy avoidance
scope: Remove the unnecessary mutable carrier clone from ordinary raw DXF section replay
Retain a mutable copy only for ACDSRECORDs with an ASM_Data owner marker
Add focused generated coverage for serialized output and caller-value preservation
Reconcile the 7S.2c writer-copy scope without claiming a writer memory bound

implementation.behavior: Ordinary opaque sections are validated and streamed directly from the caller-owned const carrier vectors. ACDSDATA is scanned read-only for an ACDSRECORD containing the exact group-2 ASM_Data marker; only that remap candidate receives a mutable copy. Schema-only ACDSDATA is streamed directly, and the existing remapper remains authoritative for candidate validation/failure behavior.
generatedControls: Generated ASCII opaque-section carrier with one raw record and one payload string
Schema-only ACDSDATA carrier without an ASM_Data owner marker
ACDSRECORD with an AcDbDs::ID owner key and generated A1-to-B2 handle mapping
Writer emits section name, record name, and payload
Caller-owned section name, typed group values, and parallel raw spellings remain unchanged
Schema-only ACDSDATA is emitted without entering the mutable remap path
ASM_Data writer emits B2 while the caller-owned typed/raw values remain A1
Duplicate ASM_Data marker fails before output and does not mutate the caller carrier

planImpact.nextUnblockedSlice: Keep the mutable copy for ACDSRECORDs containing ASM_Data; continue other bounded raw/projection owners. Public post-callback mutation remains caller-owned and requires a separate API/ownership decision before it can be quota-bound.

results: focused generated raw-section writer selector passed for common opaque, schema-only ACDSDATA, owner-remap, and malformed-candidate paths
receipt JSON and scoped diff checks passed
